description.title: Check the sequencer, validator and faucet funds on a given testnet
description.purpose:
Calls to get the funds of the various nodes and faucet, and if they fall below a certain threshold, sends alerts to discord and via SMS.
Note that tests in the check category do not store any information into the e2e test database - they either just extract data from the database to perform the check, or get snapshots from the network.
